Considering:
a. that violence against women and children is an act that violates the rights and dignity of women and children as human beings;

5.8.rationale: In the original Indonesian text excerpt, there is no explicit engagement of the private sector (e.g., “dunia usaha,” “perusahaan,” “pengusaha,” employers, chambers of commerce) as stakeholders in prevention/protection/services. The text discusses government, community, NGOs, religious actors, and service units (PPT, hospitals, police, prosecutors, courts, etc.). A mention of “kesempatan kerja … sektor formal maupun informal” appears only in a definitional explanation of gender equality (Penjelasan Pasal 2 huruf b) and does not establish private-sector participation or roles. Thus the judge’s No aligns with the Indonesian source, and the golden label “Yes” appears incorrect.
